title: The perfect transport form is derived from a minimal current action

statements.text: With an independent future-directed current as the one root object, a minimal ideal action returns current continuity, potential flow, constitutive pressure and the metric stress tensor by independent variations, so the perfect transport form is a derived branch and not an axiom.

sources.quote: The perfect transport form is therefore a derived ideal branch rather than a defining axiom.
This paper supersedes the March 2022 action formulation.
